note: Frame-selection variants compared. K is the frame cap (8 here, 8-15 allowed). Frames are re-encoded to 1024 px long side, JPEG quality 85, no metadata.
single: one still photo (the current app input)
uniform: evenly spaced in time, first and last included
time-bins: time split into K bins, sharpest frame of each bin
overlap: blur gate at 0.5 x clip median, overlap groups, sharpest per group, farthest-first to K; on a score tie the temporally farthest candidate is taken
overlap-strict: overlap with the blur gate at 0.7 x clip median
all: about 2.5 frames per second, no selection (upper bound on frame count)

merge.M1: union of normalized names across per-frame calls
merge.M2: names seen in two or more frames
merge.M3: union plus the number of frames that saw a name

model: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite through OpenRouter, temperature 0, the server's vision prompt (app.vision.gemini.PROMPT)
